=== request 1 model parent-model
{"type":"function","name":"exec","description":"Call with no parameters (or only filters, e.g. read*) to list the saved helpers per language. Run inline code in an interpreter (python, node, bash, ...). Use it to compute, filter or combine data in one call; a plain command is lang bash with the command as code. Code calls the saved helpers of its own language as fn.\u003cname\u003e(...) (python, node, ts, ruby; found when the call is made, so a helper the program just wrote works) or by a bare command name (bash); the listing shows exactly what to type. fn.\u003cname\u003e(...) runs the helper's entry function: ts/node the default export, else the export named \u003cname\u003e, else its only function; python the function named \u003cname\u003e, else its only public function; ruby self.call, else self.\u003cname\u003e, else its only singleton method. Every export stays reachable as fn.\u003cname\u003e.\u003cmember\u003e(...). Helpers may also import each other. Another language's helper is run as a subprocess from the directory in $JAD_FUNCTIONS_DIR. Pass data as input: the program reads it from stdin as JSON. Print the answer to stdout; for a short structured answer write to the file named by $JAD_RESULT to see it ahead of the raw output. It waits up to block_ms; if the program is still running you get an id and it keeps going: use the async tool to wait for, list, inspect or stop it.","parameters":{"type":"object","properties":{"lang":{"type":"string","minLength":1,"description":"Interpreter name, e.g. python, node, bash. Defaults to bash."},"code":{"type":"string","minLength":1,"description":"Program source, run by the interpreter named by lang. A plain command is lang bash with the command as code."},"filters":{"type":"array","items":{"type":"string"},"description":"Only with no code: list the saved helpers whose name or description matches every filter, case-insensitive. A filter with * or ? is a wildcard pattern (read*, *file*); any other is a substring."},"input":{"description":"Any JSON value, written to the program's standard input as one line of JSON. Without input, stdin is empty."},"cwd":{"type":"string","minLength":1,"description":"Directory to run in, relative to the workspace root or absolute. Defaults to the workspace root."},"block_ms":{"type":"integer","minimum":0,"description":"Most time to block for the result. If the program is still running an id is returned; collect it with the async tool."},"read_only":{"type":"boolean","description":"Set true for a call that changes no file: searching, listing, printing files, git log, diff or status. Read-only calls of one response may run at the same time. The call runs in a sandbox where only the plan-mode writable paths (by default the temp folder) can be written; on a host where no such sandbox works, read_only does not count and the call runs in order. In plan mode every call runs in that sandbox, and where there is none plan mode refuses calls with code."}},"additionalProperties":false},"strict":false}
{"type":"function","name":"async","description":"Manage background work started by other tools. wait: block until at least one handle finishes and return every finished one. list: your handles, active by default. status: one handle. stop: end one handle. A start that returned a handle id is still running; collect it with wait in a later call.","parameters":{"type":"object","properties":{"action":{"type":"string","enum":["wait","list","status","stop"]},"wait_ms":{"type":"integer","minimum":0,"description":"wait: most time to block; 0 polls."},"ids":{"type":"array","items":{"type":"string"},"maxItems":32,"description":"wait: only these handles. Default: all yours."},"id":{"type":"string","description":"status, stop: handle id."},"state":{"type":"string","enum":["active","done","failed","stopped","timed_out","lost","all"],"description":"list: default active."},"kind":{"type":"string","description":"list: process, subagent, ..."},"limit":{"type":"integer","minimum":1,"description":"list: page size."},"cursor":{"type":"string","description":"list: from the previous page."}},"required":[],"additionalProperties":false},"strict":false}
{"type":"function","name":"skill","description":"Load a skill's instructions by name. Call without a name to list available skills.","parameters":{"type":"object","properties":{"name":{"type":"string","description":"Skill name from the list."}},"additionalProperties":false},"strict":false}
{"type":"function","name":"subagent","description":"Hand a task to a separate agent with its own fresh context and get back only its final answer. Agents only read unless marked [can change files]. Use it for searches or reading that would fill your context. A slow agent returns a run id while it keeps working; never start the task again: use the async tool with that id to wait for it, look at it or stop it. resume continues a finished run of this session as a new run. [can change files; runs to its end] is never handed off. [can change files; may run in the background] is handed off, keeps editing after your turn ends and cannot ask the user: leave its paths alone until it ends.\nAgents:\n- explore [can change files; runs to its end] Sandboxes for sandbox: reader (Reader: writes nothing but scratch).","parameters":{"type":"object","properties":{"task":{"type":"string","minLength":1,"description":"Self-contained instructions. The agent sees nothing of this conversation. Omit to list the agents."},"agent":{"type":"string","description":"Agent name. Optional when only one is configured."},"sandbox":{"type":"string","description":"Sandbox template for this run: one of the sandboxes listed below. Omit to use the agent's own sandbox, or the session's when the agent names none. A template can only narrow what the run may read, write and reach; one that would widen it is refused."},"resume":{"type":"string","description":"Run id (sub_...) of a finished run of this session to continue from its transcript. The new run is a copy: the old run is not changed, and the result names it as resumed_from."},"block_ms":{"type":"integer","minimum":0,"description":"Most time this call blocks for the answer; 0 returns a run id at once. Clamped to the async policy. An agent marked [can change files; runs to its end] ignores it and runs to its end."}},"additionalProperties":false},"strict":false}

Run inline code in an interpreter (python, node, bash, ...). Use it to compute, filter or combine data in one call; a plain command is lang bash with the command as code. Code calls the saved helpers of its own language as fn.\u003cname\u003e(...) (python, node, ts, ruby; found when the call is made, so a helper the program just wrote works) or by a bare command name (bash); the listing shows exactly what to type. fn.\u003cname\u003e(...) runs the helper's entry function: ts/node the default export, else the export named \u003cname\u003e, else its only function; python the function named \u003cname\u003e, else its only public function; ruby self.call, else self.\u003cname\u003e, else its only singleton method. Every export stays reachable as fn.\u003cname\u003e.\u003cmember\u003e(...). Helpers may also import each other. Another language's helper is run as a subprocess from the directory in $JAD_FUNCTIONS_DIR. Pass data as input: the program reads it from stdin as JSON. Print the answer to stdout; for a short structured answer write to the file named by $JAD_RESULT to see it ahead of the raw output. It waits up to block_ms; if the program is still running you get an id and it keeps going: use the async tool to wait for, list, inspect or stop it. Sandbox: every call runs under env, which limits what it may read, write and reach; a refused file or network access is the sandbox, not a bug to work around.","parameters":{"type":"object","properties":{"lang":{"type":"string","minLength":1,"description":"Interpreter name, e.g. python, node, bash. Defaults to bash."},"code":{"type":"string","minLength":1,"description":"Program source, run by the interpreter named by lang. A plain command is lang bash with the command as code."},"filters":{"type":"array","items":{"type":"string"},"description":"Only with no code: list the saved helpers whose name or description matches every filter, case-insensitive. A filter with * or ? is a wildcard pattern (read*, *file*); any other is a substring."},"input":{"description":"Any JSON value, written to the program's standard input as one line of JSON. Without input, stdin is empty."},"cwd":{"type":"string","minLength":1,"description":"Directory to run in, relative to the workspace root or absolute. Defaults to the workspace root."},"block_ms":{"type":"integer","minimum":0,"description":"Most time to block for the result. If the program is still running an id is returned; collect it with the async tool."},"read_only":{"type":"boolean","description":"Set true for a call that changes no file: searching, listing, printing files, git log, diff or status. Read-only calls of one response may run at the same time. The call runs in a sandbox where only the plan-mode writable paths (by default the temp folder) can be written; on a host where no such sandbox works, read_only does not count and the call runs in order. In plan mode every call runs in that sandbox, and where there is none plan mode refuses calls with code."}},"additionalProperties":false},"strict":false}
